evals.$evidence: Earned by the Tier-3 detection eval (pnpm skills:evals:detection), which plants the five defects in tests/fixtures/planted-defects/ as a real working-tree diff and grades whether review reports each one. First run 2026-07-14 on ad2f48d: 5/5 (floor 4/5), confirmed by a second run, 5/5. This buys RECALL only — the eval cannot fail a review that also invents findings, so precision stays unmeasured until a clean control fixture exists.
